findings.claim_text: The first sweep was 167,464 ETH + 63 tokens incl 1.615B USDT, 3m24s after 50 authorizations (delegation 20:20:59, sweep 20:24:23 UTC)
Gross theft ~$6.36B across ten chains (TRM Labs)
findings.contradicting_quote: Binance has not published an independently verified loss figure; some analysts warn larger estimates may include transfers unrelated to the suspected attack.
Tether and Circle reportedly froze over $2 billion; figures have not been independently reconciled; Binance says around $3B frozen.
